description: Serve an app under the owner's own domain (Pro: three per account). 'attach' with a hostname (e.g. app.example.com, 64 characters at most) answers the DNS record the owner must add (CNAME to clients.dropyour.site) and the state 'en_attente'; the domain serves once the DNS points to Dropyour and the certificate is issued ('actif'). 'status' re-checks it and returns the domain, the removed domains that still redirect ('removed') and how many of the three are used ('quota'); when something blocks, 'raison' says why (delai, bloque, caa, dns_parti, certificat_inactif, verification_impossible). 'detach' removes the domain without breaking any link: the name keeps its certificate and redirects to the app's dropyour.site address as long as the owner's DNS points to Dropyour, and it no longer counts in the three. You can detach on your own, no human confirmation: the activity shows your name on the line, and the owner can put it back for 30 days. To put it back yourself, 'attach' the same hostname to the same app within 30 days: it comes back as it was. While a removed name still redirects, only its owner (and, after a transfer, the previous owner) can attach it again. A refusal carries a reason code in parentheses (nom_invalide, nom_plateforme, trop_long, sans_pro, deja_rattache, app_a_un_domaine, quota, redirige_ailleurs, nom_indisponible, cloudflare_indisponible). Needs a connected account.
name: dropyour_domain
title: Custom domain of an app
